headline: Premier League MW7: Arsenal defeat Forest 2-0 to maintain pressure on City
whyCareReason: Bukayo Saka and Kai Havertz strike at the City Ground as Arsenal collect their sixth win and stay three points behind Manchester City.
teaser: Arsenal respond to City's Saturday victory with a commanding 2-0 away display in Nottingham to reach 18 points.
story: Premier League Matchweek 7 continued on Sunday 18 October as Arsenal secured a crucial 2-0 victory over Nottingham Forest at the City Ground. Knowing league leaders Manchester City had extended their tally to 21 points with Saturday's 3-1 win over Ipswich, Mikel Arteta's side needed all three points to protect their title chase. Bukayo Saka opened the scoring in the 34th minute with a curling left-footed finish into the far corner. Kai Havertz doubled the advantage in the 68th minute, heading home a pinpoint Declan Rice delivery from a set piece. Forest mounted late pressure with Morgan Gibbs-White, but David Raya made two decisive saves to keep a clean sheet. The win lifts Arsenal to 18 points (6-0-1), keeping them firmly within three points of the summit.
stakes: Second-placed Arsenal needed three points to prevent Manchester City from establishing a six-point advantage at the top of the table.
rivalryAngle: The City Ground has proven a dangerous venue in past title races, making Arteta's composed victory an emphatic statement.
funFacts: Bukayo Saka scored his fourth Premier League goal of the 2026/27 campaign.
Arsenal have kept four clean sheets in seven league fixtures.
Arsenal reach 18 points (6-0-1), sitting three points behind leaders Manchester City (21 points, 7-0-0).

keyPlayers.name: Bukayo Saka
keyPlayers.hook: Broke the deadlock in the 34th minute with a trademark cut-inside and curling finish.

keyPlayers.name: Kai Havertz
keyPlayers.hook: Secured the points with a clinical header from Rice's 68th-minute cross.

keyPlayers.name: David Raya
keyPlayers.hook: Preserved the clean sheet with two vital second-half stops.
